description: Check an upload started with start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat or start_film_upload: awaiting_file (includes the upload_url while it can still be used), uploading, ready (a hosted video comes with its details and a default embed code; a film file with the film and slot it was attached to), expired (start a new upload), or failed (chat imports only; includes failure_reason).

upload_id.description: The upload_id returned by start_video_upload or upload_video_from_chat.
